description: Source code implementing byte order swapping and buffer encoding/decoding functions for various data types in the torch::utils namespace.

methods.name: swapBytes16
methods.description: Swaps bytes of a 16-bit unsigned integer in place.

methods.name: swapBytes32
methods.description: Swaps bytes of a 32-bit unsigned integer in place.

methods.name: swapBytes64
methods.description: Swaps bytes of a 64-bit unsigned integer in place.

methods.name: THP_nativeByteOrder
methods.description: Returns the native byte order of the system (little or big endian).

methods.name: THP_decodeBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a buffer of bytes into a typed array, handling byte swapping if needed.

methods.name: THP_encodeBuffer
methods.description: Encodes a typed array into a byte buffer, handling byte swapping if needed.
